definition_en: a country or its government, a region within a country, a condition, or to say something formally
core_image: 地图上一个有边界的国家
scene: 这个国家重视教育。The state invests in education.
sceneCN: 这里 state 是「国家」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这个国家重视教育。

senses.title: Country and government
senses.definition: a country together with its government
senses.definitionCN: 一个国家及其政府
senses.example: The state invests in education.
senses.why: A political country is the oldest public sense.
senses.whyCN: 政治意义上的国家，是最古老的公共义项。

senses.title: Region of a country
senses.definition: a region within a country that has its own government
senses.definitionCN: 一国内拥有自己政府的地区
senses.example: Texas is a large state.
senses.why: A federal country divides itself into states.
senses.whyCN: 联邦制国家把自己划分为州。

senses.title: Condition
senses.definition: the condition that someone or something is in
senses.definitionCN: 某人或某物所处的状况
senses.example: The patient is in a stable state.
senses.why: A standing condition is the Latin core of the word.
senses.whyCN: 「站立着的状况」，是这个词的拉丁语核心。

senses.title: Say formally
senses.definition: to say or write something in a clear, formal way
senses.definitionCN: 以清晰正式的方式说出或写出某事
senses.example: Please state your name.
senses.why: The noun of a condition became a verb of setting out.
senses.whyCN: 表示状况的名词，转为把事情摆出来的动词。

intro.en: State comes from Latin status, a standing or condition, through Old French estat.
intro.cn: state 经古法语 estat 来自拉丁语 status（站立；状况）。

items.en: Status meant a standing or condition.
Estat named a rank or a condition.
State meant a condition and an estate.
It named a political country.
items.cn: 它开始指政治意义上的国家。

items.en: The verb sense of stating facts grew.
items.cn: 「陈述事实」的动词义发展起来。

note.en: State is compared with look-alike words and words for countries or conditions.
note.cn: 把 state 与形近词以及表示国家或状况的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: State is a country, a region of one, a condition, or the act of saying something formally.
normalIntro.cn: state 是国家、国家的一个州、一种状况，或正式陈述的动作。

normal.en: The state invests in education.
Texas is a large state.
The patient is in a stable state.
Please state your name.
The house was in a poor state.

abstract.en: To stand is to hold a place among others.
abstract.cn: 站立，就是在众人中占据一个位置。

abstract.en: A country is a people standing together.
abstract.cn: 国家，是站在一起的人民。

abstract.en: To state a fact is to stand it before others.
abstract.cn: 陈述事实，就是把它摆到众人面前。

examples.en: The state invests in education.
The patient is in a stable state.
Please state your name.

dict_mnemonic.text: state 是「国家」，也是「州」「状态」，动词是「陈述」；state of mind 是心境，in a state of 是处于……状态。

root: 来自拉丁语 status（站立；状况），经古法语 estat 进入英语；由站立的姿态，引申为国家、状态与正式陈述。

sensesIntro.en: State means a country, a region of a country, a condition, or to say something formally.
sensesIntro.cn: state 指国家、国家的州、状况，或正式陈述某事。

core.en: A standing position among things.
core.cn: 事物之中站定的位置。

branches.en: A flag flies over a parliament.
branches.cn: 一面旗在议会上方飘扬。

branches.en: A line divides one region from another.
branches.cn: 一条界线分开两个地区。

branches.en: A doctor reads a chart.
branches.cn: 医生查看图表。

branches.en: A speaker gives a clear account.
branches.cn: 发言者作出清楚的说明。

branches.en: A country and a condition are both a way of standing.
branches.cn: 国家与状况，都是一种站立的方式。

intro.en: State forms verb parts, nouns of saying, and adjectives of rank.
intro.cn: state 构成动词变化、表示陈述的名词，以及表示等级的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root status also gives static, station, and statue.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 status 还衍生出 static、station 和 statue。

items.example: The state built a new school.

items.exampleCN: 她正在陈述自己的看法。
他们走进一座宏伟的大厅。
这个无国籍家庭等待着。

items.meaning: the condition of being a state

definition_en: a place where trains stop, a broadcasting company, a post of duty, or to send someone to work in a place
core_image: 站台上停靠的火车
scene: 火车缓缓驶进车站。The train pulled slowly into the station.
sceneCN: 这里 station 是「车站」（第 1 个义项）；句意：火车缓缓驶进车站。

senses.title: Train stop
senses.definition: a place where trains or buses stop for passengers
senses.definitionCN: 火车或公交车停靠上下客的地方
senses.example: The train pulled slowly into the station.
senses.why: A stopping place for travellers is the everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 让旅客停下的地方，是最日常的义项。

senses.title: Broadcasting base
senses.definition: a company or building that sends out radio or television signals
senses.definitionCN: 发送广播或电视信号的公司或建筑
senses.example: She works for a local radio station.
senses.exampleCN: 她在一家地方电台工作。
senses.why: A fixed place for sending signals took the same name.
senses.whyCN: 发送信号的固定场所，沿用了同一个名称。

senses.title: Post of duty
senses.definition: the place where someone is assigned to work or stand guard
senses.definitionCN: 某人被分配工作或站岗的地方
senses.example: Each guard returned to his station.
senses.exampleCN: 每名卫兵回到自己的岗位。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a place where one stands.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项，就是人站定的地方。

senses.title: Assign to a place
senses.definition: to send someone to work in a particular place
senses.definitionCN: 派某人到特定地点工作
senses.example: Troops were stationed near the border.
senses.why: The place of duty became a verb of placing people.
senses.whyCN: 岗位之地，转成了安放人员的动词。

intro.en: Station comes from Latin statio, a standing place, through Old French station.
intro.cn: station 经古法语 station 来自拉丁语 statio（站立之处）。

items.en: Statio meant a standing place or post.
items.cn: statio 意为站立之处或岗位。

items.en: Station named a position or a stop.
Station meant a place of duty.
items.cn: station 指履行职责的地点。

items.en: It named a stop for trains.
It named a base for broadcasting.

note.en: Station is compared with look-alike words and words for stopping places.
note.cn: 把 station 与形近词以及表示停靠地点的词作比较。

entries.definition: a place where a bus or train halts
a main place of work or duty

normalIntro.en: Station is a place where things stand still: trains, guards, and broadcasters.
normalIntro.cn: station 是让人或物停下来的地方：火车、卫兵与广播者都在此站定。

normal.en: The train pulled slowly into the station.
She works for a local radio station.
normal.cn: 她在一家地方电台工作。

normal.en: Each guard returned to his station.
normal.cn: 每名卫兵回到自己的岗位。

normal.en: Troops were stationed near the border.
The power station supplies the town.

abstract.en: A station is a point where movement agrees to pause.
abstract.cn: 车站，是运动同意暂停的一点。

abstract.en: To be stationed is to be given a place to stand.
abstract.cn: 被派驻，就是被给予一个站立之处。

abstract.en: Every voice on the radio speaks from one fixed place.
abstract.cn: 电台里的每个声音，都从一处固定之地发出。

examples.en: The train pulled slowly into the station.
She works for a local radio station.
examples.cn: 她在一家地方电台工作。

examples.en: Troops were stationed near the border.

dict_mnemonic.text: station 是「车站」，也指「电台」「驻地」，动词是「派驻」；railway station 是火车站，power station 是发电站，stationary 是静止的。

root: 经古法语来自拉丁语 statio（站立之处）；由人站定的岗位，引申为车站、电台等固定场所，再引申为把人派驻到某地。

sensesIntro.en: Station means a train stop, a broadcasting base, a post of duty, or to send someone to a place.
sensesIntro.cn: station 指车站、电台、岗位驻地，或把人派驻到某地。

core.en: A fixed place where someone or something stands.
core.cn: 人或物站定的固定地点。

branches.en: A train slows beside a platform.
branches.cn: 火车在站台旁减速。

branches.en: A signal leaves a tall tower.
branches.cn: 信号从高塔发出。

branches.en: A guard holds one spot.
branches.cn: 卫兵守住一个位置。

branches.en: Orders send soldiers to a town.
branches.cn: 命令把士兵派往一座小镇。

branches.en: The platform and the guard post are both fixed points.
branches.cn: 站台与岗哨，都是固定的点。

intro.en: Station forms verb parts and related nouns of standing and supplies.
intro.cn: station 构成动词变化，以及表示站立与用品的相关名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root statio also gives static and statue.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 statio 还衍生出 static 和 statue。

items.example: The station is near the river.

items.exampleCN: 他们正在附近派驻部队。

items.meaning: a seller of paper and pens

latinEntries.exampleCN: statio 演变为英语的 station。

definition_en: to remain in a place, to continue in a state, or to live somewhere for a short time
core_image: 行李箱放在旅馆房间里
scene: 他们决定再住一晚。They decided to stay one more night.
sceneCN: 这里 stay 是「暂住」（第 3 个义项）；句意：他们决定再住一晚。

senses.title: Remain in place
senses.definition: to remain in a place instead of leaving
senses.definitionCN: 留在某处而不离开
senses.example: Please stay in the room.
senses.why: Remaining in a place is the core sense.
senses.whyCN: 留在某处，是这个词的核心义项。

senses.title: Continue to be
senses.definition: to continue in a particular state
senses.definitionCN: 继续处于某种状态
senses.example: Stay calm during the test.
senses.why: Remaining in place became remaining in a state.
senses.whyCN: 留在原处，引申为停留在某种状态。

senses.title: Live briefly
senses.definition: to live somewhere as a guest for a short time
senses.definitionCN: 作为客人短期住在某地
senses.example: They decided to stay one more night.
senses.why: A short stay is a brief remaining.
senses.whyCN: 暂住，就是短暂地留下。

intro.en: Stay comes from Old French ester, to remain, from Latin stare, to stand.
intro.cn: stay 来自古法语 ester（停留），源于拉丁语 stare（站立）。

items.en: Stare meant to stand.
Ester meant to remain or stay.
Staye meant to remain in a place.
It came to mean continuing in a state.
items.cn: 它转而表示保持某种状态。

items.en: It named a short visit as a guest.
items.cn: 它也指作为客人的短期逗留。

note.en: Stay is compared with look-alike words and words for remaining.
note.cn: 把 stay 与形近词以及表示留下的词作比较。

entries.definition: to stay in a place or state

normalIntro.en: Stay is to remain in a place, to keep a state, or to be a guest for a while.
normalIntro.cn: stay 是留在某处、保持某种状态，或作为客人住上一阵。

normal.en: Please stay in the room.
Stay calm during the test.
They decided to stay one more night.
We stayed at home all day.
Let us stay in touch.

abstract.en: To stay is to refuse the pull of elsewhere.
abstract.cn: 留下，就是拒绝别处的牵引。

abstract.en: A calm mind stays when the world moves.
abstract.cn: 世界移动时，平静的心仍然留在原处。

abstract.en: A short stay can still feel like home.
abstract.cn: 短暂的逗留，也能像家一样。

examples.en: Please stay in the room.
Stay calm during the test.
They decided to stay one more night.

dict_mnemonic.text: stay 是「停留」，也指「保持」和「暂住」；stay at home 是待在家里，stay in touch 是保持联系，stay calm 是保持冷静。

root: 经古法语 ester（停留）来自拉丁语 stare（站立）；站住不走，引申为停留、保持状态，以及作为客人短住。

sensesIntro.en: Stay means to remain in a place, to continue in a state, or to live somewhere briefly.
sensesIntro.cn: stay 指留在某处、保持某种状态，或短期住在某地。

core.en: Not leaving the place you are in.
core.cn: 不离开所在之处。

branches.en: A visitor keeps to one room.
branches.cn: 来客待在一个房间里。

branches.en: A hand remains steady.
branches.cn: 一只手保持稳定。

branches.en: A guest books one more night.
branches.cn: 客人再订一晚。

branches.en: Remaining in a place and staying as a guest share one word.
branches.cn: 留在某处与做客暂住，共用同一个词。

branches.en: A state that lasts is like a guest who stays.
branches.cn: 持续的状态，就像久留的客人。

intro.en: Stay forms verb parts and nouns of remaining and visiting.
intro.cn: stay 构成动词变化，以及表示停留与做客的名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root stare also gives status, station, and static.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 stare 还衍生出 status、station 和 static。

items.example: He is a stayer in the race.
items.exampleCN: 他是比赛里能坚持到底的人。
他是全职在家带孩子的家长。

latinEntries.example: Stare is the root of stay.
latinEntries.exampleCN: stare 是 stay 的词根。

definition_en: to take something that belongs to someone else, without permission
core_image: 一只手伸进别人敞开的口袋
scene: 小偷从柜台后偷走了钱。The thief stole the money from the counter.
sceneCN: 这里 steal 是「偷窃」（第 1 个义项）；句意：小偷从柜台后偷走了钱。

senses.title: Take without right
senses.definition: to take another person's property without permission
senses.definitionCN: 未经允许拿走他人的财物
senses.example: The thief stole the money from the counter.
senses.exampleCN: 小偷从柜台后偷走了钱。
senses.why: This is the plain physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最直接的物理义项。

senses.title: Take ideas
senses.definition: to use someone else's idea or work as if it were your own
senses.definitionCN: 把他人的想法或作品当作自己的使用
senses.example: He stole my idea for the design.
senses.exampleCN: 他剽窃了我的设计方案。
senses.why: An object can be taken, and so can a thought.
senses.whyCN: 物品能被拿走，想法也能。

senses.title: Move quietly
senses.definition: to move somewhere quietly so that no one notices
senses.definitionCN: 悄悄地移动到某处而不被察觉
senses.example: She stole into the room.
senses.why: A thief moves in silence, so the silence itself became the verb.
senses.whyCN: 小偷行动无声，于是「无声」本身也成了动词。

intro.en: Steal goes back to Old English stelan, a strong verb of Germanic origin.
intro.cn: steal 可追溯到古英语 stelan，是日耳曼语来源的强变化动词。

items.en: The root meant to take secretly.
Stelan meant to rob or take by stealth.
items.cn: stelan 意为抢夺或偷偷拿走。

items.en: Stelen kept the strong past form stole.
items.cn: stelen 保留了强变化过去式 stole。

items.en: Steal extended to ideas and quiet movement.
items.cn: steal 扩展到想法与悄悄移动。

items.en: The idiom steal the show named a scene stealer.
items.cn: 习语 steal the show 指抢尽风头的人。

note.en: Steal is compared with look-alike words and with words for taking wrongly.
note.cn: 把 steal 与形近词以及表示不正当拿取的词作比较。

entries.definition: to take from a person by force
to enter a building to steal

normalIntro.en: Steal starts with a hand in a pocket and ends with a silent step through a door.
normalIntro.cn: steal 从一只手伸进口袋开始，以无声的一步进门结束。

normal.en: Someone stole my bike.
Do not steal other people's work.
He stole a glance at the letter.
normal.cn: 他偷偷瞥了一眼那封信。

normal.en: The cat stole into the kitchen.
She stole the show with one song.

abstract.en: What is taken in secret still leaves a trace in the hand.
abstract.cn: 偷偷拿走的东西，仍会在手上留下痕迹。

abstract.en: A stolen idea never fits the thief.
abstract.cn: 偷来的想法，永远不合小偷的身。

abstract.en: Silence is the thief's loudest tool.
abstract.cn: 沉默是小偷最响的工具。

examples.en: The thief stole the money from the counter.
examples.cn: 小偷从柜台后偷走了钱。

examples.en: He stole my idea for the design.
examples.cn: 他剽窃了我的设计方案。

examples.en: She stole into the room.

dict_mnemonic.text: steal 是「偷」，过去式 stole、过去分词 stolen；东西能被偷，想法也能被偷，走路不出声也可以说 steal into。

root: 来自古英语 stelan（偷窃），源于日耳曼语；由秘密拿走财物，引申为盗用想法与悄悄移动。

sensesIntro.en: Steal means to take property, to take credit for an idea, or to move without a sound.
sensesIntro.cn: steal 指拿走财物、窃取想法，或无声地移动。

core.en: A hand closing on what is not its own.
core.cn: 一只手攥住不属于自己的东西。

branches.en: Coins leave a drawer in a closed fist.
branches.cn: 硬币在握紧的拳头里离开抽屉。

branches.en: A speech repeats another person's words.
branches.cn: 一篇演讲重复了别人的话。

branches.en: A door opens without a sound.
branches.cn: 一扇门无声地开了。

branches.en: Property and credit can both be carried off.
branches.cn: 财物与功劳，都能被带走。

branches.en: The quiet step is how the taking begins.
branches.cn: 安静的一步，是拿取的开始。

intro.en: Steal has irregular past forms and builds nouns of theft and secrecy.
intro.cn: steal 有规则外的过去式，并构成表示偷窃与秘密的名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

definition_en: a movement of the foot, one action in a process, or to move by putting down a foot
core_image: 一只脚落在下一级台阶上
scene: 她向前迈了一步。She took a step forward.
sceneCN: 这里 step 是「一步」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她向前迈了一步。

senses.title: A movement of the foot
senses.definition: the act of lifting and putting down one foot
senses.definitionCN: 抬起并放下一次脚的动作
senses.example: She took a step forward.
senses.why: This is the basic motion sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的动作义项。

senses.title: One stage in a process
senses.definition: one action in a series that leads to a result
senses.definitionCN: 导向结果的一系列动作中的一步
senses.example: The first step is to make a plan.
senses.why: A walk is a series of steps, and so is a method.
senses.whyCN: 走路是一连串步子，方法也是。

senses.title: A stair tread
senses.definition: a flat surface that forms one level of a stair
senses.definitionCN: 构成楼梯一级的平面
senses.example: Mind the last step.
senses.why: A foot rises from step to step.
senses.whyCN: 脚从一级台阶踏到另一级。

senses.title: Put the foot down
senses.definition: to move by putting a foot down somewhere
senses.definitionCN: 把脚放下并移动
senses.example: He stepped on my foot.
senses.why: The noun of a footfall became a verb.
senses.whyCN: 脚步的名词，转成了动词。

intro.en: Step comes from Old English stæpe, a pace, from the same Germanic family as stair.
intro.cn: step 来自古英语 stæpe（步伐），与 stair 同属日耳曼语族。

items.en: The root named a pace or tread.
Stæpe meant a single pace.
Step also named a stair tread.
Step extended to stages of a process.
items.cn: step 扩展到过程的阶段。

items.en: Phrases like step by step became common.
items.cn: step by step 等短语变得常见。

note.en: Step is compared with look-alike words and with words for movement and stages.
note.cn: 把 step 与形近词以及表示移动和阶段的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Step is one foot, then one stage, then one stair, then the act of treading.
normalIntro.cn: step 是一只脚，是一个阶段，是一级台阶，也是踏下去的动作。

normal.en: Take one step at a time.
The next step is a phone call.
Watch the step at the door.
Do not step on the wet paint.
We moved step by step.

abstract.en: A long road is only many small steps.
abstract.cn: 长路不过是许多小步。

abstract.en: Each step hides the next one.
abstract.cn: 每一步都藏着下一步。

abstract.en: What you step on can also lift you.
abstract.cn: 你踩住的东西，也能把你托起。

examples.en: She took a step forward.
The first step is to make a plan.
He stepped on my foot.

dict_mnemonic.text: step 是「一步」，也是做事的一个「步骤」，还是「台阶」；作动词是「踩」；step by step 是一步步地，take a step 是迈出一步。

root: 来自古英语 stæpe（步伐），源于日耳曼语，与 stair 同族；由脚的移动引申为过程的阶段与楼梯的踏步。

sensesIntro.en: Step is a foot movement, a stage in a process, a stair, or the act of treading.
sensesIntro.cn: step 是脚的移动、过程的阶段、一级台阶，或踩踏的动作。

core.en: A foot leaving the ground and landing.
core.cn: 一只脚离地又落地。

branches.en: A shoe moves forward on a road.
branches.cn: 一只鞋在路上向前。

branches.en: A list numbers what comes first.
branches.cn: 一张清单标出先做什么。

branches.en: A foot finds a flat stone in a stair.
branches.cn: 脚在楼梯上找到一级平台。

branches.en: A boot presses down on soft ground.
branches.cn: 靴子压进松软的地面。

branches.en: Progress climbs one level at a time.
branches.cn: 进展，一次只上一级。

intro.en: Step takes plural and verb endings and forms compounds of movement and stages.
intro.cn: step 加复数与动词词尾，并构成表示移动与阶段的复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: We must step up the pace.

definition_en: continuing up to now, not moving, or even more so
core_image: 一池没有一丝波纹的静水
scene: 他仍然在等她。He is still waiting for her.
sceneCN: 这里 still 是「仍然」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他仍然在等她。

senses.title: Up to now
senses.definition: continuing until the present time, often longer than expected
senses.definitionCN: 持续至今，常比预期更久
senses.example: He is still waiting for her.
senses.why: This is the everyday time sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最日常的时间义项。

senses.title: Not moving
senses.definition: completely quiet and without movement
senses.definitionCN: 完全安静而没有动作
senses.example: The lake was still at dawn.
senses.why: This is the physical calm sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是物理上的平静义项。

senses.title: Even more
senses.definition: used to make a comparison stronger
senses.definitionCN: 用于加强比较的程度
senses.example: That is still better.
senses.why: Something unchanged in time can add emphasis.
senses.whyCN: 时间上不变的东西，也能用来加强语气。

senses.title: Distilling device
senses.definition: a device used to distil liquid
senses.definitionCN: 用于蒸馏液体的装置
senses.example: The still turned water into vapour.
senses.why: This is a separate noun from the adverb.
senses.whyCN: 这是与副词同形的另一个名词。

intro.en: Still the adjective comes from Old English stille, quiet; the adverb grew from the same word.
intro.cn: 形容词 still 来自古英语 stille（安静），副词义由同一个词发展而来。

items.en: The root meant motionless.
Stille meant quiet and calm.
Still began to mean up to now.
Still also strengthened comparisons.
A separate noun named a distilling pot.

note.en: Still is compared with look-alike words and with words for quiet and for continuation.
note.cn: 把 still 与形近词以及表示安静和持续的词作比较。

entries.definition: the ability to do something well

normalIntro.en: Still is time that will not end, water that will not move, and a comparison pushed one step further.
normalIntro.cn: still 是不肯结束的时间，是不肯流动的水，也是再往前推一步的比较。

normal.en: She is still asleep.
Stand still and do not speak.
The night was still.
It is still colder today.
He kept still behind the door.

abstract.en: What is still has not chosen to move yet.
abstract.cn: 静止的东西，只是还没选择动。

abstract.en: Time that is still is time that is waiting.
abstract.cn: 静止的时间，就是等待的时间。

abstract.en: Quiet water shows the sky more clearly.
abstract.cn: 静水把天空照得更清楚。

examples.en: He is still waiting for her.
The lake was still at dawn.
Stand still and do not speak.

dict_mnemonic.text: still 作副词是「仍然、还」，也可加强比较「更」；作形容词是「静止的、平静的」，stand still 是站着不动；另有名词义「蒸馏器」。

root: 来自古英语 stille（安静、不动），源于日耳曼语；由静止引申为时间上的持续「仍然」，再引申为加强比较的「更」。

sensesIntro.en: Still marks what continues, what does not move, what is even more so, or a distilling pot.
sensesIntro.cn: still 标记持续之事、静止之物、更进一步的程度，或一只蒸馏锅。

core.en: Water with no ripple on it.
core.cn: 没有一丝波纹的水。

branches.en: A lamp burns in a window all night.
branches.cn: 一盏灯整夜亮在窗里。

branches.en: A pond holds the sky without a wave.
branches.cn: 池塘无波地映着天空。

branches.en: One answer is good and another is better.
branches.cn: 一个答案不错，另一个更好。

branches.en: Vapour cools and becomes drops in a pot.
branches.cn: 蒸汽在锅中冷却成滴。

branches.en: What stays calm also stays on.
branches.cn: 保持平静的，也一直在延续。

intro.en: Still takes comparison and builds a noun of quiet.
intro.cn: still 加比较级，并构成表示寂静的名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

definition_en: goods kept for sale, a share in a company, or a supply kept for future use
core_image: 货架上整齐码放的存货
scene: 这家店库存不足。The shop is short of stock.
sceneCN: 这里 stock 是「库存」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这家店库存不足。

senses.title: Goods on hand
senses.definition: goods kept in a shop or store ready to be sold
senses.definitionCN: 商店或仓库里备着可供出售的货物
senses.example: The shop is short of stock.
senses.why: This is the everyday shop sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是商店里最日常的义项。

senses.title: Company share
senses.definition: a share in the ownership of a company
senses.definitionCN: 公司所有权中的一份
senses.example: He bought stock in the firm.
senses.exampleCN: 他买了这家公司的股票。
senses.why: A stored value became a tradeable share.
senses.whyCN: 储存的价值，变成了可交易的份额。

senses.title: Keep a supply
senses.definition: to keep goods ready for future use
senses.definitionCN: 为将来使用而备好货物
senses.example: They stock food for winter.
senses.why: The noun of a supply became a verb.
senses.whyCN: 储备的名词，转成了动词。

senses.title: Cooking liquid
senses.definition: a liquid made by cooking meat or vegetables, used as a base
senses.definitionCN: 煮肉或蔬菜得到的液体，用作底汤
senses.example: Add a cup of chicken stock.
senses.why: Stock as a base is another line of meaning.
senses.whyCN: 作为底子的高汤，是另一条词义线。

intro.en: Stock comes from Old English stocc, a tree trunk or post.
intro.cn: stock 来自古英语 stocc，指树干或木桩。

items.en: The root named a trunk or stick.
Stocc meant a tree trunk.
Stock named a supply or base.
Stock came to mean goods and shares.
The cooking sense named a soup base.

note.en: Stock is compared with look-alike words and with words for supplies and shares.
note.cn: 把 stock 与形近词以及表示存货和股份的词作比较。

entries.definition: a soft covering for the foot
a part of a company's value

normalIntro.en: Stock is a trunk that became a store of goods, a share in a firm, and a pot of soup base.
normalIntro.cn: stock 是从树干变成的存货，是公司里的一份股，也是一锅汤底。

normal.en: The item is in stock.
The book is out of stock.
He bought stock in the company.
normal.cn: 他买了这家公司的股票。

normal.en: We stock up before winter.
Add some vegetable stock.

abstract.en: What stands in a warehouse is wealth not yet used.
abstract.cn: 堆在仓库里的，是尚未使用的财富。

abstract.en: A trunk holds branches; a stock holds possibilities.
abstract.cn: 树干撑着枝条，储备撑着可能。

abstract.en: To take stock is to count what you can still use.
abstract.cn: 盘点，就是数一数还能用的东西。

examples.en: The shop is short of stock.
He bought stock in the firm.
examples.cn: 他买了这家公司的股票。

examples.en: Add a cup of chicken stock.

dict_mnemonic.text: stock 由「树干、基础」引申为「库存」和「股票」，也可指汤的「高汤」；in stock 是有货，out of stock 是缺货，take stock of 是评估。

root: 来自古英语 stocc（树干、木桩）；由主干、底子引申为存货与资本股份，另一支引申为汤的底子即高汤。

sensesIntro.en: Stock is goods on hand, a company share, a stored supply, or a cooking base.
sensesIntro.cn: stock 是手头货物、公司股份、储备的供应，或烹饪的高汤底。

core.en: A trunk that holds what grows.
core.cn: 托住一切生长的树干。

branches.en: Boxes sit on shelves behind a counter.
branches.cn: 箱子码在柜台后的架上。

branches.en: A name is printed on a share certificate.
branches.cn: 一个名字印在股票凭证上。

branches.en: Cans are carried down to a cellar.
branches.cn: 罐头被搬进地窖。

branches.en: Bones simmer slowly in a pot.
branches.cn: 骨头在锅里慢慢炖。

branches.en: Goods and supplies are the same thing seen twice.
branches.cn: 货物与储备，是同一件事的两种看法。

intro.en: Stock takes plural and verb endings and forms compounds of trade and supply.
intro.cn: stock 加复数与动词词尾，并构成表示贸易与供应的复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: She hung a stocking by the fire.
items.exampleCN: 她在炉边挂了一只长袜。

items.example: They built a stockpile of grain.

items.meaning: a place where shares are traded

definition_en: the organ that digests food, or the front of the body below the chest
core_image: 一个微微鼓起的袋子装满了食物
scene: 他吃得太快，胃开始疼。He ate too fast and his stomach hurt.
sceneCN: 这里 stomach 是「胃」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他吃得太快，胃开始疼。

senses.title: The digestive organ
senses.definition: the organ in the body where food is digested
senses.definitionCN: 体内消化食物的器官
senses.example: His stomach hurt after lunch.
senses.why: This is the basic organ sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的器官义项。

senses.title: The belly
senses.definition: the front part of the body below the chest
senses.definitionCN: 胸部以下的身体前部
senses.example: The ball hit him in the stomach.
senses.why: The organ names the whole area around it.
senses.whyCN: 器官的名称转指它周围的整片区域。

senses.title: Bear something
senses.definition: to accept or bear something unpleasant
senses.definitionCN: 接受或忍受令人不快的事
senses.example: I cannot stomach such rudeness.
senses.why: The stomach as the seat of feeling gives a verb.
senses.whyCN: 胃被视为情绪之所，由此引申出动词。

intro.en: Stomach travelled from Greek through Latin and French into English.
intro.cn: stomach 从希腊语经拉丁语和法语传入英语。

items.en: Stomachos named the mouth of the stomach.
Latin stomachus named the organ and temper.
items.cn: 拉丁语 stomachus 既指器官，也指性情。

items.en: Old French estomac carried the word onward.
items.cn: 古法语 estomac 把这个词继续传递下去。

items.en: Stomach meant the organ, appetite, and anger.
items.cn: stomach 既指器官，也指食欲与怒气。

items.en: Stomach also came to mean the belly.

note.en: Stomach is compared with look-alike words and with words for the belly.
note.cn: 把 stomach 与形近词以及表示腹部的词作比较。

entries.definition: the front of the body below the chest
an informal word for the stomach

normalIntro.en: The stomach is a bag that turns food into strength.
normalIntro.cn: 胃是一个把食物变成力气的袋子。

normal.en: My stomach is full.
Do not swim on a full stomach.
A stomach ache kept her home.
The smell turned my stomach.
He has no stomach for quarrels.

abstract.en: The stomach is the body's quiet kitchen.
abstract.cn: 胃是身体里安静的厨房。

abstract.en: Courage was once thought to sit in the stomach.
abstract.cn: 古人曾以为勇气住在胃里。

abstract.en: What we cannot stomach, we cannot swallow.
abstract.cn: 咽不下去的东西，也忍受不了。

examples.en: He ate too fast and his stomach hurt.
The ball hit him in the stomach.
I cannot stomach such rudeness.

dict_mnemonic.text: stomach 是「胃」，也指「腹部」；stomach ache 是胃痛，on an empty stomach 是空腹，have no stomach for 是对某事没兴趣或没胆量。

root: 源自希腊语 stomachos（胃的开口），经拉丁语 stomachus 与古法语 estomac 进入英语；由器官本身，引申为腹部，再引申为「忍受」这一心理动作。

sensesIntro.en: Stomach is the digestive organ, the belly, or the ability to bear something.
sensesIntro.cn: stomach 是消化器官、腹部，或忍受某事的能力。

core.en: A soft bag that receives food.
core.cn: 一个接收食物的柔软袋子。

branches.en: His stomach hurt after lunch.
branches.cn: 午饭后他的胃疼。

branches.en: The ball hit him in the stomach.
branches.cn: 球打在他的腹部。

branches.en: I cannot stomach such rudeness.
branches.cn: 我受不了这种无礼。

branches.en: Organ and belly share one word.
branches.cn: 器官与腹部共用同一个词。

branches.en: What the belly rejects, the mind refuses.
branches.cn: 肚子排斥的，心里也拒绝。

intro.en: Stomach takes endings and builds words about the belly.
intro.cn: stomach 加词尾，构成与腹部相关的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin form stomachus sits behind the English word.
latinIntro.cn: 英语这个词背后是拉丁语形式 stomachus。

items.example: She is not stomaching the noise.
Do not take it on an empty stomach.
He has no stomach for fighting.

latinEntries.meaning: the gullet, the organ, and temper
latinEntries.example: The Latin word covered the organ and the mood.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 这个拉丁词兼指器官与情绪。

definition_en: to cease moving or doing something, to block, or a place where a bus stops
core_image: 一只抬起的手掌挡住前行的脚步
scene: 红灯亮了，汽车停了下来。The light turned red and the car stopped.
sceneCN: 这里 stop 是「停止」（第 1 个义项）；句意：红灯亮了，汽车停了下来。

senses.title: Cease moving
senses.definition: to cease moving or doing something
senses.definitionCN: 停止移动或停止做某事
senses.example: The car stopped at the light.
senses.why: This is the basic sense of halting.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示停止的基本义项。

senses.title: Prevent
senses.definition: to prevent something from happening or continuing
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某事发生或继续
senses.example: They stopped the leak in time.
senses.why: Halting an action becomes preventing it.
senses.whyCN: 让动作停下，引申为阻止。

senses.title: Plug a hole
senses.definition: to block a hole or passage
senses.definitionCN: 堵住孔洞或通道
senses.example: He stopped the bottle with a cork.
senses.exampleCN: 他用软木塞塞住了瓶子。
senses.why: The oldest sense was to plug with tow.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项正是用麻絮塞住。

senses.title: A bus stop
senses.definition: a place where a bus or train picks up people
senses.definitionCN: 公交车或火车上下客的地方
senses.example: We met at the bus stop.
senses.why: The place where motion stops takes the name.
senses.whyCN: 运动停下的地点沿用了这个词。

intro.en: Stop first meant to plug a hole, then to halt.
intro.cn: stop 最初表示塞住孔洞，后来才表示停下。

items.en: Latin stuppa meant tow, coarse fibre.
items.cn: 拉丁语 stuppa 指麻絮、粗纤维。

items.en: Stoppian meant to plug with tow.
Stop broadened to mean to halt.
items.cn: stop 的词义扩展为停下。

items.en: Stop also meant to prevent.
A stop became a place for buses.
items.cn: stop 成为公交车站的名称。

note.en: Stop is compared with look-alike words and with words for halting.
note.cn: 把 stop 与形近词以及表示停止的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Stop is a hand raised against motion.
normalIntro.cn: stop 是一只对着运动举起的手。

normal.en: The bus stops here.
Stop talking, please.
We stopped to rest.
The cork stops the bottle.
I will stop by after work.

abstract.en: A stop is a small promise to look before going on.
abstract.cn: 停一下，是继续之前先看一眼的小小承诺。

abstract.en: Some stops are endings and some are breaths.
abstract.cn: 有些停下是终结，有些只是呼吸。

abstract.en: You cannot stop the river, only choose where to stand.
abstract.cn: 你拦不住河水，只能选择站在哪里。

examples.en: The light turned red and the car stopped.
examples.cn: 红灯亮了，汽车停了下来。

examples.en: They stopped the leak in time.
We met at the bus stop.

dict_mnemonic.text: stop 是「停止」；stop doing 是停止做，stop to do 是停下来去做，bus stop 是公交车站，put a stop to 是制止某事。

root: 可追溯至拉丁语 stuppa（麻絮），古英语 stoppian 本义是「用麻絮塞住」；由堵塞孔洞，引申为让运动与行为停下，再引申为阻止与车站。

sensesIntro.en: Stop means to halt, to prevent, to plug, or a place where vehicles halt.
sensesIntro.cn: stop 表示停下、阻止、堵塞，或车辆停靠的车站。

core.en: Motion meeting a wall.
core.cn: 运动撞上了一堵墙。

branches.en: The car stopped at the light.
branches.cn: 汽车在红灯前停下。

branches.en: They stopped the leak in time.
branches.cn: 他们及时止住了漏水。

branches.en: He stopped the bottle with a cork.
branches.cn: 他用软木塞塞住了瓶子。

branches.en: We met at the bus stop.
branches.cn: 我们在公交车站见面。

branches.en: The stop is where the stopping happens.
branches.cn: 车站，正是停车发生的地方。

intro.en: Stop doubles its final letter and builds words for halting.
intro.cn: stop 变化时双写词尾，并构成表示停止的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source stuppa meant tow used for plugging.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源 stuppa 指用来堵塞的麻絮。

items.example: Put the stopper in the bottle.
We met at the bus stop.

latinEntries.structure: Latin stuppa to Old English stoppian
latinEntries.example: The earliest stop was a plug.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 最早的 stop 就是一个塞子。

definition_en: a shop, a supply kept for future use, or to keep something for later
core_image: 货架后面堆满货物的库房
scene: 这家店周末很忙。The store is busy on weekends.
sceneCN: 这里 store 是「商店」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这家店周末很忙。

senses.title: A shop
senses.definition: a shop where goods are sold
senses.definitionCN: 出售商品的店铺
senses.example: The store opens at nine.
senses.why: This is the everyday American sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是美式英语中日常的商店义项。

senses.title: A supply kept
senses.definition: a supply of something kept for future use
senses.definitionCN: 留待将来使用的储备
senses.example: They keep a store of wood.
senses.why: The shop and the stock share one idea of keeping.
senses.whyCN: 商店与存货共享「存放」这一概念。

senses.title: Keep for later
senses.definition: to keep something for future use
senses.definitionCN: 把某物留待将来使用
senses.example: We stored the boxes in the attic.
senses.exampleCN: 我们把箱子存在阁楼里。
senses.why: The noun turns into the act of keeping.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为存放的动作。

intro.en: Store came through Old French from a Latin verb for setting up.
intro.cn: store 经古法语来自一个表示建立的拉丁语动词。

items.en: Instaurare meant to set up or renew.
Estorer meant to furnish or supply.
Store named a supply kept ready.
Store named a shop in America.
items.cn: store 在美式英语中指商店。

items.en: Store spread to data kept on machines.
items.cn: store 扩展到机器保存的数据。

note.en: Store is compared with look-alike words and with words for shops and supplies.
note.cn: 把 store 与形近词以及表示商店和储备的词作比较。

entries.definition: a place where goods are sold

normalIntro.en: A store sells what it keeps, and keeps what it sells.
normalIntro.cn: 商店卖它存的东西，也存它要卖的东西。

normal.en: The store is busy on weekends.
Store the rice in a dry place.
normal.cn: 把米存放在干燥的地方。

normal.en: They store up food for winter.
There is a surprise in store for you.
The phone stores thousands of photos.
normal.cn: 这部手机存着数千张照片。

abstract.en: A store is a promise made to tomorrow.
abstract.cn: 商店，是向明天许下的承诺。

abstract.en: We store what we cannot yet use.
abstract.cn: 我们存放的，是暂时用不上的东西。

abstract.en: Every shelf holds a small future.
abstract.cn: 每一层货架，都托着一点未来。

examples.en: The store is busy on weekends.

senses.why: A street name can stand for a whole trade.
senses.whyCN: 一条街名可以代表整个行业。

intro.en: Street comes from Latin strata, a paved road, through Old English stræt.
intro.cn: street 经由古英语 stræt，来自拉丁语 strata，意为铺砌的道路。

items.en: Strata meant a paved road.
Stræt named a Roman road.
items.cn: stræt 指罗马人修筑的道路。

items.en: Strete came to mean any town road.
items.cn: 中古英语 strete 泛指城镇道路。

items.en: Street named the public life of a town.
items.cn: street 也开始指城镇的公共生活。

items.en: Street names stood for trades, as with Wall Street.
items.cn: 街名可以代指行业，如华尔街。

note.en: Street is compared with look-alike words and with words for roads.
note.cn: 把 street 与形近词以及表示道路的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Street is stone laid down so a town can move.
normalIntro.cn: street 是铺下来的石头，让整座城镇得以流动。

normal.en: The shop is across the street.
We met at the street corner.
Street lights came on at dusk.
The main street was full of people.
He grew up on the streets.

abstract.en: A street is a river made of stone.
abstract.cn: 街道是一条石头做的河。

abstract.en: Every street carries two stories, one each way.
abstract.cn: 每条街都载着两个方向的故事。

abstract.en: The street belongs to everyone and no one.
abstract.cn: 街道属于所有人，也不属于任何人。

examples.en: The children played football in the street.
Many people are living on the streets.
She works on Wall Street.

dict_mnemonic.text: street 来自「铺好的路」；两旁有房子的路是街道，路上的公共生活是街头，用作街名时还能代表一个行业。

root: 来自拉丁语 strata（铺砌的路），经古英语 stræt 进入英语；由罗马人修筑的石路，泛化为城镇街道，再引申为街头生活与街名代称。

sensesIntro.en: Street is a paved town road, the public life on it, and a name that can stand for a trade.
sensesIntro.cn: street 是铺好的城镇道路、路上的公共生活，以及能代指行业的街名。

core.en: Stone paving between two rows of houses.
core.cn: 两排房子之间铺着石头的路。

branches.en: Cars pass between the buildings.
branches.cn: 车辆在楼宇之间穿行。

branches.en: A musician plays on the pavement.
branches.cn: 乐手在人行道上演奏。

branches.en: A name plate marks the road.
branches.cn: 一块路牌标出这条街。

branches.en: The road becomes a stage.
branches.cn: 道路成了舞台。

branches.en: A street name can hold a whole trade.
branches.cn: 一个街名可以装下整个行业。

intro.en: Street forms a plural and compounds with everyday words.
intro.cn: street 有复数形式，并能与日常词构成复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is strata, a paved road.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源是 strata，意为铺砌的道路。

items.meaning: knowing how to survive in a city

items.example: They met at the street corner.

items.meaning: the chief street of a town

latinEntries.example: The Latin strata gave us street.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 strata 给了我们 street 这个词。

definition_en: worry caused by a difficult situation, special importance given to something, or the stronger sound in a word
core_image: 一根被拉紧的弦，绷得快要发出声音
scene: 考试前他感到很大压力。He felt a lot of stress before the exam.
sceneCN: 这里 stress 是「压力」（第 1 个义项）；句意：考试前他感到很大压力。

senses.title: Mental pressure
senses.definition: worry and tension caused by a difficult situation
senses.definitionCN: 困难处境造成的担忧与紧张
senses.example: He felt a lot of stress before the exam.
senses.exampleCN: 考试前他感到很大压力。
senses.why: This is pressure on the mind.
senses.whyCN: 这是压在心里的压力。

senses.title: Special emphasis
senses.definition: special importance given to something
senses.definitionCN: 给予某事物的特别重视
senses.example: The teacher stressed the need for rest.
senses.exampleCN: 老师强调了休息的必要。
senses.why: The mind presses on one point.
senses.whyCN: 心思在这里压住了一个重点。

senses.title: Strong sound
senses.definition: the stronger sound in a word or phrase
senses.definitionCN: 单词或短语中读得更强的音
senses.example: Put the stress on the first syllable.
senses.exampleCN: 把重音放在第一个音节上。
senses.why: Voice pressure marks the beat.
senses.whyCN: 声音的力度标出了节拍。

intro.en: Stress comes from distress, from Old French destrece, narrowness or hardship.
intro.cn: stress 由 distress 截短而来，源自法语 destrece，意为狭窄与艰难。

items.en: Strictus meant drawn tight.
Destrece named hardship and tightness.
Distresse named great trouble.
items.cn: 中古英语 distresse 指巨大的困苦。

items.en: Stress shortened the word and kept the pressure.
items.cn: stress 截短了词形，保留了压力之意。

items.en: It also named vocal emphasis.
items.cn: 它也开始指语音上的重音。

note.en: Stress is compared with look-alike words and with words for pressure.
note.cn: 把 stress 与形近词以及表示压力的词作比较。

entries.definition: force or worry pressing on someone

normalIntro.en: Stress is a tightened string, whether in the mind, the voice, or the sentence.
normalIntro.cn: stress 是一根绷紧的弦，可能在心里、在声音里，也可能在句子里。

normal.en: Too much stress harms sleep.
She stressed the value of teamwork.
normal.cn: 她强调了团队合作的价值。

normal.en: The word has stress on the second syllable.
normal.cn: 这个词的重音在第二个音节。

normal.en: He is under great stress at work.
normal.cn: 他工作时承受着巨大压力。

normal.en: Do not stress out over small things.

abstract.en: Stress is weight the mind puts on itself.
abstract.cn: 压力，是心给自己加的重量。

abstract.en: A stressed string can still make music.
abstract.cn: 绷紧的弦，依然能奏出音乐。

abstract.en: What we stress, we remember.
abstract.cn: 我们强调什么，就会记住什么。

examples.en: He felt a lot of stress before the exam.
examples.cn: 考试前他感到很大压力。

examples.en: The teacher stressed the need for rest.
examples.cn: 老师强调了休息的必要。

examples.en: Put the stress on the first syllable.
examples.cn: 把重音放在第一个音节上。

dict_mnemonic.text: stress 本义是「拉紧」；心里拉紧是压力，说话时把某点压重是强调，读音时把某个音节压重就是重音。

root: 源自拉丁语 strictus（拉紧），经法语 destrece 与中古英语 distresse 演变，截短为 stress；由紧绷与困苦，引申为心理压力、语义强调与语音重音。

sensesIntro.en: Stress is tension in the mind, weight on a point, and force in the voice.
sensesIntro.cn: stress 是心里的紧张、给某点的分量，以及声音里的力度。

core.en: A string pulled until it hums.
core.cn: 一根被拉到嗡嗡作响的弦。

branches.en: A student cannot sleep before the test.
branches.cn: 学生考前睡不着。

branches.en: A teacher repeats one key point.
branches.cn: 老师反复讲一个重点。

branches.en: One syllable sounds louder.
branches.cn: 一个音节读得更响。

branches.en: What we keep stressing becomes our worry.
branches.cn: 我们反复强调的东西，会变成忧虑。

branches.en: Emphasis in meaning lands as stress in sound.
branches.cn: 意思上的强调，落在声音上就是重音。

intro.en: Stress takes verb endings and builds adjective and noun forms.
intro.cn: stress 加动词词尾，并构成形容词与名词形式。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is strictus, drawn tight.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 strictus，意为拉紧的。

items.example: The bank passed the stress test.
items.exampleCN: 这家银行通过了压力测试。

definition_en: having great physical power, great in degree or effect, or not easily broken
core_image: 一个人稳稳拉住绷紧的绳子，纹丝不动
scene: 他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。He is strong enough to carry the sack of rice.
sceneCN: 这里 strong 是「强壮的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。

senses.title: Physically powerful
senses.definition: having great physical power
senses.definitionCN: 身体力量很大的
senses.example: He is strong enough to carry the sack of rice.
senses.exampleCN: 他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。
senses.why: This is power in the body.
senses.whyCN: 这是身体里的力量。

senses.title: Great in degree
senses.definition: great in force, taste, or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 在力度、味道或情感上很强的
senses.example: A strong wind blew all night.
senses.why: The idea of force spreads to wind and taste.
senses.whyCN: 力量的概念扩展到了风和味道。

senses.title: Hard to break
senses.definition: solid and not easily broken or damaged
senses.definitionCN: 结实而不易损坏的
senses.example: The bridge is strong enough for trucks.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥足够坚固，能承受卡车。
senses.why: A body's strength becomes a structure's.
senses.whyCN: 身体的强度变成了建筑的强度。

intro.en: Strong comes from Old English strang, powerful.
intro.cn: strong 来自古英语 strang，意为强大的。

items.en: Strang meant physically powerful.
The root also named tightness and severity.
items.cn: 这个词根也含有紧绷与严厉之意。

items.en: Strong kept the sense of power.
items.cn: 中古英语 strong 仍指力量。

items.en: Strong described wind, taste, and feelings.
items.cn: strong 开始形容风、味道与情感。

items.en: It also described solid structures.
items.cn: 它也用来形容坚固的结构。

note.en: Strong is compared with look-alike words and with words for power.
note.cn: 把 strong 与形近词以及表示强大的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Strong is power you can see in an arm, feel in wind, or trust in a bridge.
normalIntro.cn: strong 是手臂上看得见的力量、风里感觉得到的力量，也是桥上可以依靠的力量。

normal.en: She is stronger than she looks.
A strong wind shook the windows.
He has strong opinions about food.
normal.cn: 他对食物有强烈的看法。

normal.en: Cooking is her strong point.
This coffee is too strong for me.
normal.cn: 这咖啡对我来说太浓了。

abstract.en: Strength is quiet until it is needed.
abstract.cn: 力量在需要之前，总是安静的。

abstract.en: A strong wind can move a strong tree.
abstract.cn: 强风能摇动坚固的树。

abstract.en: The strongest thing is often the most patient.
abstract.cn: 最强的东西，往往最有耐心。

examples.en: He is strong enough to carry the sack of rice.
examples.cn: 他很强壮，能扛起那袋米。

examples.en: A strong wind blew all night.
The bridge is strong enough for trucks.
examples.cn: 这座桥足够坚固，能承受卡车。

dict_mnemonic.text: strong 的核心是「有力」；人有力量是强壮，风有力量是强烈，桥有力量是坚固，咖啡有力量是浓。

root: 来自古英语 strang（强大的），属日耳曼语词，与 strength、strengthen 同源；由身体的力量，扩展到风、味道、情感等强度，再指结构的坚固。

sensesIntro.en: Strong is power in a body, force in wind or taste, and firmness in a structure.
sensesIntro.cn: strong 是身体的力量、风与味道的强度，以及结构的坚固。

core.en: A rope held tight without shaking.
core.cn: 一根被拉紧却毫不抖动的绳。

branches.en: A worker lifts a heavy sack.
branches.cn: 工人扛起沉重的麻袋。

branches.en: Branches bend in a gale.
branches.cn: 树枝在狂风中弯下。

branches.en: A bridge carries trucks daily.
branches.cn: 桥每天承载卡车。

branches.en: A strong body and a strong wind meet.
branches.cn: 强壮的身体遇上强劲的风。

branches.en: What is strong inside resists what is strong outside.
branches.cn: 内在坚固的，才扛得住外在强大的。

intro.en: Strong takes comparison and builds noun, adverb, and verb forms.
intro.cn: strong 有比较级，并构成名词、副词与动词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: He is the strongest of all.
items.exampleCN: 他是所有人中最强壮的。

definition_en: a person who studies at a school or college, or someone who studies a subject seriously
core_image: 一个背着书包、抱着书走进教室的年轻人
scene: 她是本校的学生。She is a student at this school.
sceneCN: 这里 student 是「学生」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她是本校的学生。

senses.title: A person at school
senses.definition: someone who is studying at a school or college
senses.definitionCN: 在学校或大学学习的人
senses.example: She is a student at this school.
senses.why: This is the everyday school sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最日常的在校学生义项。

senses.title: A serious learner
senses.definition: someone who studies a subject with care and interest
senses.definitionCN: 认真钻研某一主题的人
senses.example: He is a student of ancient history.
senses.exampleCN: 他是研究古代史的学者。
senses.why: The role outlives the classroom.
senses.whyCN: 这个身份可以延续到教室之外。

intro.en: Student comes from Latin studium, eagerness or study.
intro.cn: student 来自拉丁语 studium，意为热忱或钻研。

items.en: Studium meant eager attention.
Estudiant named a person who studies.
Student named a learner at a school.
items.cn: 中古英语 student 指学校里的学习者。

items.en: It also named a careful researcher.
items.cn: 它也开始指认真的研究者。

items.en: Student life became a common phrase.
items.cn: student life 成为常用说法。

note.en: Student is compared with look-alike words and with words for learners.
note.cn: 把 student 与形近词以及表示学习者的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A student is someone whose main work is learning.
normalIntro.cn: student 是把学习当作主要工作的人。

normal.en: The students filled the hall.
She is a college student.
Student life is busy but fun.
He is a student of human nature.
The exchange student arrived today.

abstract.en: Every student is a beginner with a future.
abstract.cn: 每个学生，都是带着未来的初学者。

abstract.en: To stay curious is to stay a student.
abstract.cn: 保持好奇，就一直是学生。

abstract.en: The best students keep asking why.
abstract.cn: 最好的学生一直在问为什么。

examples.en: She is a student at this school.
He is a student of ancient history.
examples.cn: 他是研究古代史的学者。

examples.en: The exchange student arrived today.

dict_mnemonic.text: student 与 study 同源，核心是「用心钻研的人」；在学校读书的是学生，把某个领域钻研一辈子的是研究者。

root: 来自拉丁语 studium（热忱、钻研），经古法语 estudiant 进入英语；由用心学习的人，引申为对某一领域认真研究的人。

sensesIntro.en: Student names a learner at school, and also a serious student of a subject.
sensesIntro.cn: student 指学校里的学习者，也指认真研究某一主题的人。

core.en: A bag of books on a young shoulder.
core.cn: 年轻肩膀上的一包书。

branches.en: A class begins at eight.
branches.cn: 八点开始上课。

branches.en: A researcher reads old papers.
branches.cn: 研究者翻阅旧论文。

branches.en: A pupil raises a hand.
branches.cn: 小学生举起手。

branches.en: The classroom is the first laboratory.
branches.cn: 教室是第一间实验室。

branches.en: A student of anything never stops asking.
branches.cn: 任何领域的钻研者，都不会停止发问。

intro.en: Student forms a plural and connects to study and studious.
intro.cn: student 有复数，并与 study、studious 相连。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is studium, eager study.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 studium，意为热切的钻研。

items.exampleCN: 一位交换生加入了我们。

definition_en: to learn about a subject, to examine something carefully, or a room used for reading and writing
core_image: 一盏台灯下摊开的书，旁边放着写满字的笔记本
scene: 她每天晚上学习两个小时。She studies for two hours every evening.
sceneCN: 这里 study 是「学习」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她每天晚上学习两个小时。

senses.title: Learn a subject
senses.definition: to spend time learning about a subject
senses.definitionCN: 花时间学习某一科目
senses.example: She studies for two hours every evening.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天晚上学习两个小时。
senses.why: This is the everyday learning sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最日常的学习义项。

senses.title: Examine carefully
senses.definition: to examine something carefully to understand it
senses.definitionCN: 仔细考察某事物以理解它
senses.example: The team studied the problem for weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 团队研究这个问题研究了好几个星期。
senses.why: Learning turns outward to the world.
senses.whyCN: 学习在这里转向了外部世界。

senses.title: A reading room
senses.definition: a room in a house used for reading and writing
senses.definitionCN: 家中用于读书写作的房间
senses.example: He keeps his books in the study.
senses.why: The action gets a room of its own.
senses.whyCN: 这个动作有了自己的房间。

intro.en: Study comes from Latin studium, eagerness, through Old French.
intro.cn: study 来自拉丁语 studium（热忱），经古法语进入英语。

items.en: Studium meant eager effort.
Estudie named study and care.
Studie meant to learn or examine.
items.cn: 中古英语 studie 意为学习或考察。

items.en: Study also named a room for books.
Case study named a close examination.

note.en: Study is compared with look-alike words and with words for learning.
note.cn: 把 study 与形近词以及表示学习的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Study is effort turned toward knowledge, and the room that holds it.
normalIntro.cn: study 是朝向知识的用力，也是容纳这份用力的房间。

normal.en: He studies history at university.
We studied the map before leaving.
normal.cn: 出发前我们研究了地图。

normal.en: She studies hard for exams.
The report is a case study.
normal.cn: 这份报告是一个个案研究。

normal.en: The study was warm and quiet.

abstract.en: Study is a conversation with people you never meet.
abstract.cn: 学习，是和从未谋面的人交谈。

abstract.en: The more we study, the more we see.
abstract.cn: 研究得越多，看见的就越多。

abstract.en: A quiet room can hold a loud idea.
abstract.cn: 安静的房间，能装下响亮的思想。

examples.en: She studies for two hours every evening.
examples.cn: 她每天晚上学习两个小时。

examples.en: The team studied the problem for weeks.
examples.cn: 团队研究这个问题研究了好几个星期。

examples.en: He keeps his books in the study.

dict_mnemonic.text: study 的核心是「用心钻研」；在学校用心是学习，对一个问题用心是研究，专门用来用心的房间就是书房。

root: 来自拉丁语 studium（热忱、钻研），经古法语 estudie 进入英语；由学习与考察的动作，引申为研究，再指家中读书写作的书房。

sensesIntro.en: Study is learning, careful research, or the room where both happen.
sensesIntro.cn: study 是学习、仔细研究，或让这两件事发生的书房。

core.en: A lamp, a book, and a page filling with notes.
core.cn: 一盏灯、一本书、一页渐渐写满的笔记。

branches.en: A student reads until midnight.
branches.cn: 学生读到半夜。

branches.en: A team checks every detail.
branches.cn: 团队核查每个细节。

branches.en: Books line a quiet room.
branches.cn: 书排满一间安静的房间。

branches.en: Reading turns into finding out.
branches.cn: 阅读变成了探究。

branches.en: The room and the work share a name.
branches.cn: 房间与工作共用一个名字。

intro.en: Study takes verb endings and builds noun, adjective, and adverb forms.
intro.cn: study 加动词词尾，并构成名词、形容词与副词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is studium, eager effort.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 studium，意为热切的努力。

items.meaning: a close study of one case
items.exampleCN: 他们写了一份个案研究。

definition_en: showing a lack of good sense, or slow to understand
core_image: 脑子像被敲了一下，愣在原地转不过弯
scene: 他问了一个愚蠢的问题。He asked a stupid question.
sceneCN: 这里 stupid 是「愚蠢的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他问了一个愚蠢的问题。

senses.title: Foolish
senses.definition: showing a lack of good judgment
senses.definitionCN: 缺乏良好判断力的
senses.example: He asked a stupid question.
senses.exampleCN: 他问了一个愚蠢的问题。
senses.why: This is the main sense of poor judgment.
senses.whyCN: 这是表示判断力差的主要义项。

senses.title: Slow to learn
senses.definition: slow to understand or learn something
senses.definitionCN: 理解或学习某事很慢的
senses.example: I felt stupid when I could not solve it.
senses.exampleCN: 解不出来的时候，我觉得自己很笨。
senses.why: The word shifts from judgment to ability.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从判断力转向了能力。

senses.title: Annoying
senses.definition: used informally to show annoyance
senses.definitionCN: 口语中用来表示恼怒
senses.example: I forgot my stupid keys again.
senses.exampleCN: 我又忘了那串烦人的钥匙。
senses.why: Anger lends the word a casual use.
senses.whyCN: 恼怒让这个词有了口语用法。

intro.en: Stupid comes from a Latin word meaning stunned.
intro.cn: stupid 来自拉丁语词，意为被惊得发愣。

items.en: Stupere meant to be stunned or numb.
Stupidus described a stunned, foolish person.
items.cn: stupidus 形容发愣、愚笨的人。

items.en: Stupide carried the sense into French.
items.cn: stupide 把这一含义带入法语。

items.en: Stupid described a foolish person or act.
items.cn: stupid 形容愚笨的人或行为。

items.en: Stupid became a common word of annoyance.
items.cn: stupid 成为常见的恼怒用语。

note.en: Stupid is compared with look-alike words and with words for foolishness.
note.cn: 把 stupid 与形近词以及表示愚笨的词作比较。

entries.definition: not sensible, often in a light way

normalIntro.en: Stupid is the mind standing still when it should move.
normalIntro.cn: stupid 是头脑该动的时候却停住了。

normal.en: He asked a stupid question.
normal.cn: 他问了一个愚蠢的问题。

normal.en: I felt stupid when I could not solve it.
normal.cn: 解不出来的时候，我觉得自己很笨。

normal.en: I forgot my stupid keys again.
normal.cn: 我又忘了那串烦人的钥匙。

normal.en: That was a stupid mistake.
How stupid of me to leave it outside.

abstract.en: Stupid is often just brave without information.
abstract.cn: 所谓愚蠢，常常只是没有信息的勇敢。

abstract.en: No one is stupid in every room.
abstract.cn: 没有人在每个房间里都笨。

abstract.en: The stupidest answer is the one never checked.
abstract.cn: 最笨的答案，是从未被核对的答案。

examples.en: He asked a stupid question.
examples.cn: 他问了一个愚蠢的问题。

examples.en: I felt stupid when I could not solve it.
examples.cn: 解不出来的时候，我觉得自己很笨。

examples.en: That was a stupid mistake.

dict_mnemonic.text: stupid 是「愚蠢的」，也可表示「笨的」或口语里「恼人的」；stupid question 是愚蠢的问题，stupid mistake 是愚蠢的错误，feel stupid 是觉得自己很傻。

root: 来自拉丁语 stupere（惊呆、麻木）的形容词 stupidus，经法语 stupide 进入英语；由被惊得发愣，引申为头脑迟钝、缺乏判断，再有了口语里表示恼怒的用法。

sensesIntro.en: Stupid means foolish, slow to understand, or, informally, annoying.
sensesIntro.cn: stupid 表示愚蠢、迟钝，或口语中令人恼火。

core.en: A mind stopped by its own confusion.
core.cn: 被自己的困惑卡住的头脑。

branches.en: He asked a stupid question.
branches.cn: 他问了一个愚蠢的问题。

branches.en: I felt stupid when I could not solve it.
branches.cn: 解不出来的时候，我觉得自己很笨。

branches.en: I forgot my stupid keys again.
branches.cn: 我又忘了那串烦人的钥匙。

branches.en: Foolish acts and slow thinking share one word.
branches.cn: 愚蠢的行为和迟钝的思考共用一个词。

branches.en: A word for bad judgment became a word of anger.
branches.cn: 表示判断力差的词，也成了发怒时用的词。

intro.en: Stupid builds nouns and adverbs with -ity and -ly.
intro.cn: stupid 借助 -ity 和 -ly 构成名词和副词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base stup- meant stunned.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 stup- 意为惊呆。

items.example: It was the stupidest thing to say.
items.exampleCN: 那是能说出的最蠢的话。

items.example: He stupidly left the door open.
She could not believe his stupidity.
items.exampleCN: 她不敢相信他会这么蠢。

items.example: One stupid mistake cost them the game.
items.exampleCN: 一个愚蠢的错误让他们输掉了比赛。
我为开口问而觉得自己很傻。

latinEntries.exampleCN: stupidus 演变为英语的 stupid。
